outcome: Admission to neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: One hundred and twelve healthy pregnant women were divided into an intervention group (receiving antenatal exercise education) and a control group (receiving standard maternal health care).
finding: Antenatal exercise was associated with statistically significant improvements in fetal heart rate, Apgar score, neonatal complications, and NICU admission, but not neonatal weight.
birth_weight: N/A (though neonatal weight was an outcome, specific inclusion/exclusion criteria for birth weight of the cohort are not mentioned)
